title: CUTLERY CANTEEN WITH NATIONAL...
reason: Large floral repousse canteen of about 100+ pieces; title says National Silver Co. (plated) but no marks are visible, so check back stamps.
findings: A timber canteen with a lower drawer, both lined in dark green baize, holding a large matching set of flatware with deep all over floral repousse style handles. Rough count of about 100 to 130 pieces (not exact): dinner and dessert forks, soup spoons, dessert spoons, teaspoons, butter knives, table knives with plain stainless looking blades, a pierced slice or server, and a few small round items in the centre tray. The photos do not show the backs of handles or bowls and no blade stamp is readable, so no hallmark, EPNS, sterling or National Silver Co. mark is visible; the title's National Silver Co. attribution (a plate maker) is not confirmed by the photos and plate versus sterling cannot be judged. Pattern name not readable.
condition: Looks bright and fairly complete; light tarnish in the handle detail; some light scratches on blades; canteen box intact with minor wear on the drawer front.
rescore_note: Large floral repousse canteen of 100+ pieces in a drawered box, bright and fairly complete, but the named maker is a plate maker and no hallmark is visible, so I treat it as silver plate (sterling very unlikely); plated sets sell slowly, so lower 5-6 band.
